description: Which names does Excel read as a reference where it expects a name? Asked two ways over overlapping lists. (1) Table names: a one-table workbook written by this library under each name, opened interactively; a name Excel does not accept makes it offer to repair the package. (2) Sheet names: a worksheet renamed to each name over COM, then a formula ='<name>'!B2 assigned on another sheet and read back through Range.Formula, which returns Excel's own quoting. Every name tried both ways was quoted exactly when it was refused as a table name.
probe: .claude/skills/excel-gui-automation/scripts/open-verdict.ps1 per table workbook; a one-off COM script for the sheet-name quoting
openClass: interactive-open (open-verdict.ps1, repair prompt dismissed with No)

tableDisplayName.note: name MyTable with displayName 'My Display Name' draws the repair prompt; displayName MyDisplay opens clean
